Medical Marketer Job at Clinix Healthcare




        
    

        
        Clinix Healthcare has 40 years of qualitative experience in Medical and Diagnostic services with over 120 centers across Africa. The state-of-the art Diagnostic Centre represents a milestone towards fulfilling Clinix strategic objectives in providing a world class integrated health system that ensures excellence in health and healthcare for all as a globally recognized destination for healthcare. Clinix Healthcare Nigeria is the first investment in West Africa. The Principal investor is Greenlife Pharmaceuticals and Bliss Gvs Pharmaceuticals. Both companies have outstanding repute in the Nigerian Healthcare industry.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Medical Marketer
     

            
    



Job Location: Awoyaya / VGC Branch, Lagos

Job Description


	We are seeking a dynamic, results-driven, and experienced Medical Marketer to join our team at the Awoyaya / VGC Branch.
	The ideal candidate will play a vital role in increasing brand visibility, driving patient acquisition, building strong relationships with referring doctors and corporate organizations, and promoting our diagnostic and healthcare services in the community.


Responsibilities


	Develop and execute strategic marketing plans to promote Clinix Healthcare services at the Awoyaya / VGC Branch.
	Create engaging promotional content, flyers, social media posts, carousels, and campaigns for health awareness and service promotion.
	Build and maintain relationships with medical practitioners, corporate clients, pharmacies, and community organizations for referrals and partnerships.
	Organize and coordinate outreach activities, health talks, screenings, and events to increase patient footfall.
	Manage and grow the branch’s digital presence (Google Business Profile, Instagram, WhatsApp, etc.) and respond to online inquiries.
	Track marketing performance, generate reports on leads, conversions, and ROI, and recommend improvements.
	Collaborate with the clinical and operations team to highlight new services, packages, and success stories.
	Ensure all marketing activities comply with medical ethics, regulatory guidelines, and brand standards.


Qualifications


	Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Business Administration, or a related field.
	2–3 years of relevant marketing experience (healthcare experience is a strong advantage).
	Valid driver’s license and willingness to carry out field visits (added advantage).


Requirements & Skills:


	Proven experience in healthcare/medical marketing or pharmaceutical sales.
	Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust quickly.
	Creative thinking and excellent content creation skills (visuals, copywriting, social media).
	Proficiency in digital marketing tools, Google Business Profile, and basic analytics.
	Self-motivated, target-oriented, and able to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
	Good knowledge of the Lagos healthcare landscape, especially Eti-Osa / Awoyaya / VGC axis.
	Ability to speak persuasively and represent the brand professionally.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Application Letter and CV to: [email protected] and copy [email protected] using "Medical Marketer – Awoyaya/VGC" as the subject of the mail.

Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Manager Energy Law Job at Eni Nigeria




        
    

        
        Eni is one of the most important, vertically integrated energy companies in the world. It operates in the oil, natural gas, electricity production, engineering, construction and petrochemical products sectors. It is constantly working to build a future where everyone can access energy resources efficiently and sustainably.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Manager Energy Law
Job ID: 33184
Job Location: Abuja
Contract type: Permanent.

Job Summary
     

            
    




	At Eni, we are looking for an Energy Law Manager within Nigerian Agip Exploration Ltd in Abuja, Nigeria.
	You will be responsible for providing legal assistance, advice, and support to NAE and Eni’s subsidiaries in Nigeria in both internal and external processes, covering contractual, administrative, judicial, and extrajudicial matters, in accordance with applicable laws and the policies, rules, and procedures established by the Company.


Main responsibilities


	Support company departments with timely advice on all legal matters relating to contracts, licences, commercial agreements, portfolio management activities (e.g. M&A, farm?out/in activities), governance and corporate secretarial matters, as well as applicable laws and regulations.
	Support company departments in attending meetings with third parties and governmental authorities in relation to NAE’s activities in Nigeria.
	Participate in ad hoc working groups with internal and/or external parties.
	Manage and engage on relevant legal issues with industry stakeholders and partners.
	Manage legal representation and defence in relation to disputes and litigation, including the management of external legal providers and the assessment of the quality of the contributions received.
	Liaise with external legal providers appointed by NAE and Eni’s subsidiaries in Nigeria and/or in relation to NAE’s activities in Nigeria.
	Regularly liaise with the Eni Legal Department, ensuring the prompt reporting of all relevant legal issues.


Requirements
Skills and experience required:


	Law Degree from a top Nigerian university.
	Registration with the Nigerian Bar Association.
	Previous experience in similar managerial roles, either in?house or in private practice.
	You must be eligible to live and work in Nigeria to apply for this position.
	Language requirements: Fluent level of English.


Note


	Applications are only accepted through our online application system.
	Please upload your CV in English.

  "description": "JC International is a leading provider of Training, Inspection, Asset Integrity Management, and Pipeline &amp; Process Services to the energy and industrial sectors. We are committed to operational excellence, innovation, and delivering world-class solutions to our clients.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Logistics Officer

Job Location: Port Harcourt, Rivers
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a competent and resourceful Logistics Officer to support our Logistics, Mobilization &amp; Materials Coordinator in ensuring the efficient coordination of personnel, materials, equipment, transportation, and logistics activities across our operations.


Key Responsibilities


	Coordinate the mobilisation and demobilisation of personnel, equipment, and materials for projects and training programmes.
